nodes.name: SecuritySection.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the OS Agent security settings panel covering access mode, command risk rules, workspace path restrictions, and blocklist/allowlist textareas.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces for the OS Agent settings subpage, including gateway status, automation status, and credential status shapes.

nodes.name: useAgentConfigBase.ts
nodes.summary: Shared hook foundation implementing load / debounced-save / undo behaviour common to both OS Agent and SDE Agent config hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Centralizes a 500ms debounced-save + undo-stack pattern so per-agent hooks only add agent-specific logic on top.

nodes.name: useOSAgentConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that loads/saves the OS Agent configuration via RPC, layering credential-status checking on top of useAgentConfigBase.

nodes.name: useOSAgentGateway.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing the OS Agent gateway lifecycle (start/stop/refresh) and polling its status via RPC.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Utility functions for reading and writing deeply-nested keys (dot-path) in the OS Agent's untyped config record, plus safe deletion.

nodes.name: AgentRulesSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the agent automation-rules/policies table with search, sorting, per-rule toggling, and workspace-restriction controls.

nodes.name: useAgentRules.ts
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper hook over the shared useSharedPolicies hook, re-exporting policy types for the AgentOrgs rules section.

nodes.name: useSdeAgentConfig.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that loads/saves the SDE Agent configuration via RPC, built on useAgentConfigBase with agent-specific path handling.

nodes.name: AgentModelsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Large shared settings section for configuring an agent's model selection, context window, and advanced compaction options across agent types.

nodes.name: AgentRuntimeLimitsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section for configuring agent runtime limits (e.g. max concurrency/timeouts) shared across agent config pages.

nodes.name: ModelPicker.tsx
nodes.summary: Dropdown component for selecting a model account, sourced from the Rust-compatible accounts list and grouped/sorted for display.

nodes.name: PersonalitySection.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section allowing users to edit and copy an agent's personality/system-prompt text, shared across agent config pages.

nodes.name: SubAgentsEditor.tsx
nodes.summary: Editor component for attaching/removing sub-agents to a parent agent, including a searchable add-agent dropdown and cycle-detection when linking sub-agents.

nodes.name: WorkspaceSettingsToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Small reusable toggle component for enabling per-workspace overrides of an agent setting.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Settings section listing an agent's skills with search filtering, delegating table rendering to AgentSkillsTable.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsTable.tsx
nodes.summary: Sortable table rendering an agent's skills with storage-location labels and per-skill enable/disable toggling.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsetsSection.tsx
nodes.summary: Composes the workspace-settings toggle, skills section, and MCP section into a unified 'skillsets' tab for agent configuration.

nodes.name: useSkills.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that loads an agent's skills list via RPC and exposes optimistic toggle/refresh operations.

nodes.name: useAgentDefinitions.ts
nodes.summary: Core hook that fetches all agent definitions from the Rust backend, splits them into built-in/custom agents, listens for backend change events, and exposes add/remove operations.

nodes.name: useAgentOrgs.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that loads the list of agent organizations via RPC and exposes a refresh callback.

nodes.name: useEnsureAgentDefs.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight hook that ensures agent definitions are loaded into shared atoms exactly once, without mounting the full useAgentDefinitions hook.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level AgentOrgs page component that renders the orgs/agents tables, handles org CRUD, wizard flows, and routes between table and detail views.

nodes.name: agentOrgsActiveTabAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom lifting the AgentOrgs detail panel's active-tab state out of local component state so it is shared across sibling components and testable.

nodes.name: builtInAgentsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Jotai atoms holding agent definitions fetched from the Rust backend (full list, built-in/custom splits, load state, and load error), populated by useAgentDefinitions.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Core TypeScript type definitions for the Agent Teams / Agent Orgs page: agent tiers, sub-agent isolation, hierarchy modes, plan-approval policies, and CLI agent prefixes.

nodes.name: commandRiskRulesFromConfig
nodes.summary: Derives the command-risk-rule list (always-ask, blocklist, forbidden paths) from the raw config record using nested-getter helpers.

nodes.name: SecuritySection
nodes.summary: Main security settings component: access-mode selector, command risk rule textareas, and workspace path restriction controls wired to the config update callback.

nodes.name: useAgentConfigBase
nodes.summary: Implements the shared load/debounced-save/undo pattern reused by useOSAgentConfig and useSdeAgentConfig.

nodes.name: useOSAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Loads and persists the OS Agent config via RPC, with debounced credential-status re-checking after model changes.

nodes.name: useOSAgentGateway
nodes.summary: Manages OS Agent gateway start/stop actions and polls gateway status on an interval.

nodes.name: getNestedString
nodes.summary: Reads a string value from a nested config record given a dot-path, returning a fallback when missing or wrong type.

nodes.name: getNestedNumber
nodes.summary: Reads a numeric value from a nested config record given a dot-path, returning a fallback when missing or wrong type.

nodes.name: getNestedBool
nodes.summary: Reads a boolean value from a nested config record given a dot-path, returning a fallback when missing or wrong type.

nodes.name: getNestedStringArray
nodes.summary: Reads a string-array value from a nested config record given a dot-path, returning a fallback when missing or wrong type.

nodes.name: getNestedRecord
nodes.summary: Reads a nested record (object) value from a config record given a dot-path, returning a fallback when missing or wrong type.

nodes.name: setNested
nodes.summary: Immutably sets a value at a dot-path within a config record, cloning intermediate objects along the path.

nodes.name: deleteNested
nodes.summary: Immutably deletes a key at a dot-path within a config record, cloning intermediate objects along the path.

nodes.name: AgentRulesSection
nodes.summary: Renders and filters the agent policy/rules table (search, sort, per-rule enable toggle) and workspace restriction toggle.

nodes.name: useAgentPolicies
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper hook that delegates to the shared useSharedPolicies hook for a given workspace path.

nodes.name: useSdeAgentConfig
nodes.summary: Loads and persists the SDE Agent config via RPC, built on top of useAgentConfigBase.

nodes.name: AgentModelsSection
nodes.summary: Renders the shared model-configuration UI: primary model picker, context-window options, and an advanced compaction settings panel, reading/writing nested config fields.

nodes.name: AgentRuntimeLimitsSection
nodes.summary: Renders runtime-limit input controls (e.g. numeric limits) bound to the agent's nested config via getNestedNumber/update.

nodes.name: ModelPicker
nodes.summary: Dropdown for choosing a model account, built from Rust-compatible accounts grouped via useModelAccountLookup and sorted alphabetically.

nodes.name: PersonalitySection
nodes.summary: Editable personality/system-prompt textarea with character count, copy-to-clipboard, and debounced save to config.

nodes.name: AddSubAgentButton
nodes.summary: Dropdown button listing candidate agents to add as sub-agents, filtering out already-added agents and self-reference.

nodes.name: wouldCreateCycle
nodes.summary: Graph traversal (BFS) helper that detects whether linking a candidate sub-agent would introduce a cycle in the sub-agent hierarchy.

nodes.name: SubAgentsEditor
nodes.summary: Main editor listing an agent's current sub-agents with remove/add actions and per-sub-agent settings (worktree isolation, concurrency).

nodes.name: WorkspaceSettingsToggle
nodes.summary: Renders a labelled toggle switch for enabling per-workspace settings overrides.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsSection
nodes.summary: Loads and filters an agent's skills via useSkills, rendering search input and delegating the list to AgentSkillsTable.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsTable
nodes.summary: Sortable skills table showing name, storage location, required binaries/env, and an enable/disable toggle per skill.

nodes.name: AgentSkillsetsSection
nodes.summary: Composes WorkspaceSettingsToggle, AgentSkillsSection, and AgentMcpSection into a single skillsets configuration tab.

nodes.name: useSkills
nodes.summary: Fetches an agent's skills over RPC and provides optimistic toggle/refresh operations with cancellation on unmount.

nodes.name: useAgentDefinitions
nodes.summary: Fetches all agent definitions via RPC, splits them into built-in vs custom, writes results into shared atoms, listens for backend-pushed change events, and exposes refresh/add/remove operations.

nodes.name: useAgentOrgs
nodes.summary: Loads the agent organizations list via RPC on mount and exposes state plus a refresh callback.

nodes.name: useEnsureAgentDefs
nodes.summary: Ensures agent definitions are fetched into shared atoms exactly once per app lifetime, skipping redundant loads if already loaded.

nodes.name: AgentOrgsPage
nodes.summary: Top-level page component rendering org/agent tables, handling org CRUD via RPC, wizard open/close flows, and switching between table and detail-view content based on the URL.
